config.description: Address of the deployed SchnorrAccount this server drives (0x + 40 hex).

config.label: Base URL of the Keyban backend
config.description: Base URL of the Keyban backend. Accepts a full URL, or one of the environment aliases dev, testing, staging, prod and sandbox.

config.label: Optional pre-generated FROST client share, base64-encoded JSON
config.description: Optional pre-generated FROST client share, base64-encoded JSON. Used by hosted runtimes with no OS keyring; it does not replace the invite key.
